thread:
nina (EngRuntime): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: kernel-v4 rollout. sharing a short prewarm + smoke checklist so leads can run locally / in canary.

raj (VP Eng): thanks nina. high level ask: prove p95/p99 under realistic seq dist and microbatch mix before ramp.

nina (EngRuntime): agreed. checklist draft below. shout if we missed something.

lucy (Product): please include a note about hosted vs dedicated perf targets. product needs to sync messaging.

nina (EngRuntime): added. dedicated p99 target 350ms @batch8/1k; hosted p99 target 450ms @batch4/1k.

alex (EngOps): will someone own running the smoke runs for canary startup?

tom (Eng SRE): I can. plan to run canary smoke at 08:30 PT tomorrow; will post raw traces.

mike (Infra): perms: granting canary-run to @tom for 24h. also note: enable eviction-debug=on for the first window.

nina (EngRuntime): checklist (short):
- build: kernel-v4 tagged `v4-rc` and docker pushed
- perf matrix: runs for batch sizes [1,4,8,16] and seq lens [128,256,512,1024]
- microbatch mix: 60% single, 30% microbatch-4, 10% batch-8 synthetic workload
- KV cache: ensure warmup script writes `kv:v4:` keys for contexts we will test
- telemetry: emit sample_id and client_tier tags, p50/p95/p99 latency + per-token rate
- smoke: run `./tools/smoke_test --workload micro --seq-dist=prod.json --rps=100 --duration=10m`
- rollback: fallback to kernel-v3 variant if p99 > threshold or error_rate > 1.5%

lucy (Product): add customer-visible note re: potential cache-warm latency blip for first 10m.

nina (EngRuntime): added note. also: KV eviction policy unchanged; we only version keys so reads fallback maintained.

alex (EngOps): can we get a small script for quick local warmup? saves time for on-call to repro.

nina (EngRuntime): sure. paste below:```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# quick warmup for v4 keys
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
  curl -sS -X POST https://canary.internal/api/warm -d '{"key":"kv:v4:ctx'$i'","payload":"x"}' || true
done
```

tom (Eng SRE): thanks. I'll run warmup + smoke and capture flamegraphs. will share links.

mike (Infra): reminder: run with `--cpu-isolation=high` on canary so kernel perf matches prod GPUs.

nina (EngRuntime): telemetry thresholds for canary guard: p99 <= 600ms (auto-fail), error_rate <= 0.015 (auto-fail), token-throughput within 20% of baseline.

lucy (Product): product will draft a short comms blurb describing expected transient degradation during warmup and SLOs across tiers.

raj (VP Eng): good plan. one ask: include a short doc section on how microbatching affects cost per-token. ops and finance will want a ballpark.

nina (EngRuntime): will add estimated token-cost delta table to the perf matrix.
